desktop.setup: test ! -e ~/.actions-runners/sunrise/paused && set -a && . ~/.actions-runners/sunrise/.env && set +a && export PATH=$(cat ~/.actions-runners/sunrise/.path) && eval "$(vscreen env)"
desktop.note: ludodesktop, the maintainer's own machine: only while nobody uses it (tools/ci/runner_pause.py: screen locked or untouched for 15 min, no game; a paused desktop refuses workers and stops the running ones, whose harnesses then run here); 8 jobs at most, in the CI runner's environment and slice

playsunrise.setup: test ! -e ~/.actions-runners/sunrise/paused && set -a && . ~/.actions-runners/sunrise/.env && set +a && export PATH=$(cat ~/.actions-runners/sunrise/.path) && unset WAYLAND_DISPLAY && export DISPLAY=:$(cat ~/.actions-runners/sunrise/display)

exclude.mob_ai: the vanilla oracle runs out of its 3 GB heap here (OutOfMemoryError in IO workers; passes on the desktop and the Mac) - 2026-10-26 trial
exclude.lan_integration: two clients rendered on the CPU (lavapipe): different timing subtests fail on each run (elytra, consume-release, barter, critical-hits) - 2026-10-26 trial
exclude.world_reopen: failed twice here (no Save and Quit button after reopening; the minecart-count flake), passes on the desktop - 2026-10-26 trial
exclude.remote_fireball: fails here even alone, at bare main 3b19c386c (2 of 2 runs and the retry), and passes on the Mac mini: the guest's egg is seen in 2 of 6 samples. CPU-starved: the whole sunrise-ci slice (runner on 4-7, workers on 0-3) shares a 700% quota and was throttled in 27% of periods, so lavapipe frames and screenshots outlast the projectile's flight - 2026-10-27
exclude.remote_fireworks: fails here even alone, at bare main 3b19c386c (2 of 2 runs and the retry), and passes on the Mac mini: the guest's sparks are gone by its trail screenshot (same CPU starvation as remote_fireball; a private Xvfb on CPUs 0-3 did not help) - 2026-10-27

playsunrise.note: a partner's server (Ubuntu, 8 EPYC threads, 30 GB, Detroit; tailnet only), its CI runner has CPUs 4-7, so workers get 0-3 (as tools/remote.sh runs do) and 3 jobs, in the CI runner's environment, slice and Xvfb screen (tools/ci/linux-runner.sh); the always-on Linux host since the ThinkPad stopped running harnesses (2026-10-26)

local_only.save_roundtrip: runs the game on a virtual screen (vscreen) with a null ALSA device, or offscreen in the logged-in macOS session

linux_only.save_kill: uses SIGKILL to stop the server at a save fixture point
linux_only.save_corruption: part of the Linux-only save-fault suite

solo.remote_fireball: two game windows (lan_e2e); on 4 CPUs beside other harnesses, screenshots and control requests take ticks the check needs
solo.remote_fireworks: two game windows (lan_e2e); a screenshot took ~1.5 s beside 3 other harnesses on playsunrise's runner, past the sparks' life (2026-10-27)
solo.return_to_sender: a game window: an attack on a fireball and its flight to the ghast take ticks the check needs
solo.server_player_sculk: two game windows (lan_e2e); failed on playsunrise's runner beside other harnesses, passes alone (2026-10-27)
solo.world_reopen: a game window reopening a world: failed on playsunrise's runner beside other harnesses (2026-10-27)
solo.wire_stream: a vanilla client, a vanilla server and a Sunrise client: a loaded runner delays logins past their limits

named_only.frame_identity: fails any change that moves the picture on purpose; a change that must leave it alone (HDR, shader packs) runs it by name
named_only.hdr_auto_flip: Sunrise's own HDR output, with no vanilla oracle: two games drawn offscreen on the float frame, about 5 min; run it by name on a change to HDR output or to how a renderer is replaced (#12989)
named_only.lan_integration: the whole lan_e2e suite: ~40 min a run on a loaded runner, and single checks flake under load; run it by name, or tools/lan_e2e.py
named_only.wire_stream: a real vanilla 26.3 client on a virtual screen beside a vanilla server and a headless Sunrise client, ~15 min a run; run it by name (before a pull request that changes what the client sends)
named_only.command_exec: 1 or 2 of its 19,566 commands differ in every run on main since #15161, other ones each time, on all three runners (#15158, #15316): automatic runs would fail regardless of the change; back in automatic runs with the fix
named_only.hoglin_repeat_attack: has never passed on CI since #12823 added it, and fails whatever a pull request changes (#15158): the pig's HurtTime and health after repeated hits differ; take it off this list with the fix
named_only.last_hurt_by_mob: has never passed on CI since #12843 added it, and fails whatever a pull request changes (#15158): a pig summoned with last_hurt_by_mob loses it, and the saved key order differs; take it off this list with the fix
named_only.mob_command_damage_vibration: has never passed on CI since #11179 added it, and fails whatever a pull request changes (#15158): 25 of 184 records differ, mostly sensor messages; take it off this list with the fix
